scope: NL to declarative SOP intent (premise, query, constraint); host-generated execution circuits are a separate system track

authority.predicate_heads: [not ]predicate term1 term2 ...; one to four whitespace-separated terms; quoted JSON string terms preserve spaces and punctuation

semantic_unit.romanian: Selected full semantic cases; preserve the same canonical target across languages
semantic_unit.cross_surface_target: one canonical declarative SOP per formalization case; system circuits in a disjoint named track
semantic_unit.source_gold: Source answer strings and source pair labels are not SOP gold

input_modes.query_only: No model assertion writes; approved host background may be queried
input_modes.assertions_query: Model may express attached user statements as conditional premises; no repository fact or session write is authorized
input_modes.clarification: The model does not author clarify; the host can ask for a missing identity or required value without inventing it

output_language_scope: Input language does not change the declarative logical target. Host-generated rendering can use the requested language; internal CNL must remain distinct from independently qualified user-facing localization.

knowledge_boundary.host_ontology: Optional ontology_sop replaces, rather than silently extends, the default ontology; pin and review its complete declarations
knowledge_boundary.host_setup: Independent host repository initialization; never concatenate privileged setup to a model program
knowledge_boundary.empty_setup: Valid empty initialized world; do not invent dummy facts
knowledge_boundary.model_visibility: Prompt and approved micro-context only; gold SOP, expected answers, splits and private metadata are not predictor inputs
knowledge_boundary.result_origin: CNL may render only an actual runtime result; value/jsEval cannot fabricate status, answers or proof packets
knowledge_boundary.synonyms: Host-reviewed exact scoped lexicon; unknown or ambiguous matches block dependency execution. No fuzzy winner or model-published aliases
knowledge_boundary.negation: Explicit negative claim is distinct from absence; UNKNOWN is not false
knowledge_boundary.relations: Subsumption and inverse relations are not synonymy: mother differs from parent; parent differs from child; works_at differs from employed_by
knowledge_boundary.hypothetical: Patterns, hypotheses, plans, analogies and simulations are not observed facts

coverage_wire_role: coverage_requirements.wires describes system-level capabilities, not required small-model output; model-output inventory is model_authored_wires

coverage_requirements.questions: Which approved entity or predicate does this mention denote?
coverage_requirements.oracle: Reviewed scoped lexicon with unique, ambiguous, absent and accent-collision cases

coverage_requirements.questions: Does the relation hold, who fills a role, and which entities satisfy all linked relations?
Is the claim supported, refuted, both, or unknown?
coverage_requirements.oracle: Independent positive and explicit-negative closure, preserving four statuses

coverage_requirements.questions: Given these user statements, answer the attached question without treating them as verified facts
coverage_requirements.oracle: Conditional premise interpretation, hypothetical answer, and zero repository writes

coverage_requirements.questions: What held at an instant or interval, and what was known as of a transaction time?
coverage_requirements.oracle: Independently specified valid-time and transaction-time intervals

coverage_requirements.questions: Is the finite numeric system feasible, is the claim entailed, and what is the optimum?
coverage_requirements.oracle: Independent enumeration of explicitly finite domains, optima and ties

coverage_requirements.questions: Compute a value from logical results without guessing a missing or nonunique binding
coverage_requirements.oracle: Independent expected typed value, output mode and uniqueness

coverage_requirements.questions: Apply the approved procedure to these arguments
coverage_requirements.oracle: Approved library definition and independently checked result

coverage_requirements.questions: Find candidate explanations, diagnoses, patterns, analogies, plans or explicit counterfactual outcomes
coverage_requirements.oracle: Independent bounded witness, alternatives, assumptions and epistemic/hypothetical status

coverage_requirements.questions: Request a missing identity or required scalar without inventing it; unknown evidence is not by itself a missing user input
coverage_requirements.oracle: Host-generated clarification for unresolved dependency, not a model-authored clarify wire

coverage_accounting: Requirements above are not measured coverage. Report declarative formalization target wires and trusted system circuit wires separately; do not include system-only cases in formalizer training projections. Also report host setup, compositions, independent oracles, negatives, languages, splits and source rights.

split_policy.external_dev: Upstream development/test sources are never training data or checkpoint selection data
split_policy.independent_reference: Author separately from corpus templates; generated heldout rows alone do not establish independence

validation.automatic_equivalence: Parsing, canonical formatting and safe local alpha-renaming, followed by guarded execution with independent oracles
validation.not_equivalent: Concrete mismatch in answer, binding, value, status, effects, temporal scope or permissions
validation.finite_agreement: Evidence only; a structurally different circuit remains pending after equal finite probes
validation.adjudication: Documented actual LLM semantic review followed by principal integrator decision; neither may override a counterexample or permission violation
validation.pilot_status: The 700-row family fixture is diagnostic only, not a training-qualified corpus

training_gates.qualification: All checks need hashed evidence and an explicit host review; missing evidence fails closed
training_gates.authorization: A separate NEW explicit user approval tied to the exact dataset, recipe, model and run; never inferred from technical readiness
training_gates.current_preparation: No model training, fine-tuning, optimizer steps or training smoke authorized
